bio.text: Drew Cox is a Democratic candidate for Indiana's 4th Congressional District, where Republican Jim Baird is the incumbent.
According to the Indiana Capital Chronicle's voter guide, Cox is a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and a visiting instructor at Purdue University.
The guide says he holds multiple degrees in music and an associate's degree in energy technology.
In a candidate questionnaire, Cox described himself as a lifelong Hoosier and the son of a fourth-generation farmer and a 35-year teacher.

sources.title: Crowded field for 4th Congressional District Democratic primary
